context: Use pathlib component comparisons or as_posix only at assertion/probe boundaries. Preserve native production argv paths; repair test classification rather than forcing POSIX paths into Docker commands.
description: Run 30434746317 shows ten Windows 3.10 failures across Docker lifecycle, disk-floor accounting, preflight display, and runner-log tests. Test helpers search native compose paths for '/clickhouse/' or '/postgresql/' and assertions require forward-slash substrings; on Windows they receive backslash paths, so stubs return the full compose filename, startup failures are not injected, and path assertions drift.

deferrals.reason: This item's framing ('make UAT path probes separator-neutral') and its must-preserve rule ('lifecycle accounting semantics stay unchanged') are both wrong for two of the failures it counts: test_orchestrator.py::test_disk_floor_abort_carries_startup_failed_count and ::test_disk_floor_abort_threads_startup_failed_count_into_sidecar_and_partial_report fail 'assert 0 == 1' on startup_failed_count - a genuine lifecycle-accounting bug whose fix REQUIRES changing the accounting this item promises to preserve. Working them under this framing risks weakening a correct assertion. They are now tracked separately as uat-orchestrator-startup-failed-count-not-threaded. Also: PR #1352 already fixed the test_preflight_budget.py and test_runner.py members of this item's scope by deriving expectations from the same Path the code renders rather than hardcoding separators, so the remaining path work here is test_phases.py (4 docker teardown argv assertions) and test_docker_assets.py (1); the count of 10 in the title is stale.
deferrals.resolved_reason: Adversarial review disproved the lifecycle-defect claim: both assertions fail because the test fake searches /clickhouse/ in a Windows path. Replacement item windows-uat-native-compose-path-probes-v3 keeps accounting unchanged.
deferrals.summary: Two of the 10 failures are a lifecycle defect, not path probes - split to uat-orchestrator-startup-failed-count-not-threaded

preserves.behavior: production Docker argv keeps native paths and lifecycle accounting semantics stay unchanged

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 tests/uat/test_docker_assets.py tests/uat/test_orchestrator.py tests/uat/test_phases.py tests/uat/test_preflight_budget.py tests/uat/test_runner.py -q
verifications.description: Focused UAT path and lifecycle regressions pass
